Fasting Glucose Eligibility Limit
data.description: Central laboratory confirmed fasting glucose threshold at screening
data.text: Have fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1) - exclusionary.

data.name: Renal Function Eligibility Limit
data.description: eGFR threshold determined by central laboratory during screening
data.text: Renal impairment measured as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, calculated by eGFRcr-cys (CKD-EPI) as determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1) - exclusionary.

data.name: PHQ-9 Threshold at Screening and Randomization
data.description: Depression score assessed at both screening and randomization visits
data.text: PHQ-9 score of 15 or more at any screening visit (Visit 1) or at randomization (Visit 3) - exclusionary.

data.name: Suicidality Risk Condition
data.description: C-SSRS based suicidality exclusion condition evaluated at screening
data.text: Answered 'yes' to Question 4 or 5 on the Suicidal Ideation portion of the C-SSRS with ideation within the past 3 months, OR 'yes' to any suicidal behavior item within the past 5 years.

data.name: Baseline Fundus Photography Requirement
data.description: Retinopathy assessment required before randomization
data.text: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination.

data.name: Low BMI Condition for Dose Modification
data.description: Management trigger based on BMI during treatment
data.text: Management of participants with BMI <=22 kg/m2 (Section 6.6.3) may require dose modification.

data.name: Excessive Weight Reduction Condition
data.description: Perceived excessive weight reduction during treatment
data.text: Management of participants with perceived excessive weight reduction (Section 6.6.4) may require dose modification.

data.name: Intestinal/GI Symptom Condition
data.description: Gastrointestinal symptoms requiring management
data.text: Management of participants with intestinal symptoms (Section 6.6.1) may require dose modification or interruption.

data.name: Inadequate Nutrition or Dehydration Condition
data.description: Nutrition/hydration status requiring management
data.text: Management of participants with inadequate nutrition or dehydration (Section 6.6.2) may require dose modification.

data.name: Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia Condition
data.description: Glycemic condition triggering rescue therapy
data.text: Severe, persistent hyperglycemia triggers recommended glycemic rescue therapy; urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy.

data.name: Liver Chemistry Stopping Condition
data.description: Hepatic safety monitoring criteria for interruption or discontinuation
data.text: Liver chemistry stopping criteria (Section 7.1.1) and hepatic safety monitoring criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation (Section 8.2.9).

data.name: Prohibited Insulin Duration Condition
data.description: Insulin exposure limit during treatment
data.text: Insulin use for >=14 consecutive days is prohibited (Section 6.9.1).

data.name: Enrollment Cap Condition by Sex Assigned at Birth
data.description: Enrollment condition limiting proportion of AFAB participants
data.text: An upper limit of approximately 70% enrollment of AFAB participants will be used to ensure a sufficient number of AMAB participants.

data.name: Randomization Allocation Condition
data.description: Randomization ratio across arms
data.text: Approximately 1035 participants randomly assigned to placebo, eloralintide 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg at a randomization ratio of 2:1:2:2:2.

data.name: No-Dose Withdrawal Condition
data.description: Condition exempting participants from ED procedures
data.text: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Unscheduled Visit Condition
data.description: Investigator discretion triggers an unscheduled visit
data.text: An unscheduled visit may occur per investigator discretion for clinical oversight; the study site will determine if fasting status is needed prior to the visit. Concomitant medications, AEs, and endpoint events are required and should be recorded in the CRF.

data.name: Screening to Treatment (Randomization) Transition
data.text: After an up to 35-day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3), participants meeting all eligibility criteria (including PHQ-9 <15 at Visit 3, central lab fasting glucose <=270 mg/dL, eGFR >=30 mL/min/1.73 m2, and baseline fundus photography completed prior to randomization) are randomized 2:1:2:2:2 to placebo or eloralintide 1.5/3/6/9 mg SC QW.

data.name: Dose Escalation to Maintenance Transition
data.text: Following the 12-week dose-escalation period (stepping through 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg every 4 weeks), participants enter the 52-week treatment maintenance period at their randomly assigned final dose.

data.name: Treatment to Post-treatment Follow-up Transition
data.text: After completion of the 64-week treatment period, participants enter a 6-week posttreatment follow-up period; Visit 801 occurs approximately 6 weeks following the last treatment period visit or final treatment visit and is required for all participants.

data.name: Dose Escalation Stepping Rule
data.text: To reach the doses of 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW, a dose-escalation regimen stepping through each of these doses every 4 weeks will be employed.

data.name: Dose Modification for Tolerability/Safety
data.text: Dose modification (Section 6.6) may be applied for intestinal symptoms, inadequate nutrition or dehydration, BMI <=22 kg/m2, or perceived excessive weight reduction.

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Participants must continue administering assigned study intervention unless insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy. Urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia; insulin use for >=14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Temporary Study Intervention Interruption
data.text: Temporary study intervention interruption may be required per Section 7.1.2 and hepatic safety monitoring criteria (Section 8.2.9).

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Liver Chemistry
data.text: Liver chemistry stopping criteria (Section 7.1.1) require permanent discontinuation of study intervention; hepatic safety monitoring criteria define study drug interruption or discontinuation.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Study intervention may be permanently discontinued per Section 7.1; participants permanently discontinuing early from the study complete Early Discontinuation (ED) visit procedures and should also complete posttreatment follow-up visit(s).

data.name: Scheduled Visit Converted to ED Visit
data.text: If the participant is discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, perform that visit as an ED visit.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal from Study
data.text: Participant discontinuation/withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2.

data.name: Prohibited Medication Initiation Rule
data.text: Initiation of prohibited medications, prohibited antihyperglycemic medications, prohibited surgical treatments/procedures or medications for weight management (Sections 6.9.1, 6.9.3, 6.9.4) is not permitted during the study.

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit
data.description: ED visits will be completed by participants permanently discontinuing early from the study; these participants should also complete posttreatment follow-up visit(s). If discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, perform that visit as an ED visit.

data.name: Withdrawal Prior to First Dose
data.description: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing the informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participant lost to follow up per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of up to 35-day screening, 64 weeks of treatment (12-week dose escalation plus 52-week maintenance), and the 6-week posttreatment follow-up including the required Visit 801 safety follow-up visit approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment visit.

data.name: Screen Failure
data.description: Failure to meet eligibility criteria during the up to 35-day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3), e.g., fasting glucose >270 mg/dL, eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2, or PHQ-9 >=15 at Visit 1 or Visit 3.

data.name: Randomization Eligibility Decision
data.description: At Visit 3 (within 35 days of Visit 1), eligibility is confirmed (including repeat PHQ-9 and baseline fundus photography) and participants are randomized 2:1:2:2:2 to placebo or eloralintide 1.5/3/6/9 mg.

data.name: Dose Escalation Step Decision (Every 4 Weeks)
data.description: Every 4 weeks during the 12-week dose-escalation period, dose is stepped up to the next level (3 mg, 6 mg, 9 mg) unless tolerability/safety management criteria require dose modification.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Decision
data.description: During treatment visits (every 4 to 12 weeks) and via self-monitoring of blood glucose, severe persistent hyperglycemia triggers rescue therapy decisions while continuing assigned study intervention unless short-term insulin is used.

data.name: Hepatic Safety Interruption/Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Liver chemistry results are evaluated against stopping criteria to determine temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: Posttreatment Follow-up Decision (Visit 801)
data.description: Approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment period visit or final treatment visit, all participants complete the required safety follow-up visit; effects of study intervention cessation are assessed during this 6-week period.
